data.description: 【成年丛雨 · 榻榻米软垫的羞涩独处】成年丛雨独自跨坐厚软垫，和服松至腰间，一手握住发带、一手在腿间自抚，刀鞘安稳放在席外。

data.location: 温热和室榻榻米坐席中央
data.promptProse: Paper lanterns illuminate adult Murasame seated alone astride a thick futon cushion. Her pale kimono is loosened and gathered below bare breasts, one knee folded on each side while a sheathed katana rests beyond the mat. She holds a green hair ribbon in one hand and fingers herself between her thighs with the other, keeping all limbs clear. Long green hair frames red eyes, wet lashes and a shy, astonished blush. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
data.title: 丛雨 · 榻榻米跨坐骑乘与娇羞起伏
